newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cosmos Machinery shrs end sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos Machinery shrs end sharply higher.

text.p: Shares of Cosmos Machinery Enterprises Ltd surged on Wednesday on hopes of future asset injections after China Resouces (Holdings) Ltd took a stake in the company, brokers said.
Cosmos shares jumped HK$1.245 or 64.51 percent to end at HK$3.175, after hittin an all time high of HK$3.250 in late trade. Volume was 64.48 million shares worth HK$164.72 million.

"Speculation that China Resources may raise its stake in the company in future and hopes of possible future asset injections fueled the short-term buying interest," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.

China Resources, the trading arm of China's Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, has said it may inject machinery businesses into Cosmos in the future and that its investments in machinery would be done through Cosmos.
China Resources, the parent of Hong Kong-listed China Resources Enterprise Ltd, will hold 24.3 percent of Cosmos on completion of the sale of its stake in a machinery unit to Cosmos.
